tools.name: guard_publish
tools.description: Publish one finished artwork to three places at once: the QQ fan group (with an optional @), a Bilibili dynamic post, and QQ Qzone. Use it ONCE per image; skip a platform with the `skip` field instead of calling twice.

name.description: The guard's Bilibili nickname (used for the caption and default @).

image.description: Absolute path of the finished image file.

text.description: Caption: 2-4 sentences in three beats. Do not repeat the greeting already written on the artwork.

at.description: Who to @ in the QQ group: the group card or nickname. Defaults to `name`.

group.description: QQ group number. Defaults to liveNoticeTarget in config.

summary.zh: 一张成品图一次发三处：粉丝群（可 @）、B站动态、QQ空间；要跳过某处用 skip。
summary.en: Publish one image to QQ group, Bilibili dynamic and Qzone in a single call.

tools.name: guard_check
tools.description: Look up whether someone is a current guard (舰长/提督/总督), when the membership expires, and how many drawings they still have today.

summary.zh: 查某人是不是在期舰长、到期日、今天还能画几张。
summary.en: Check guard status, expiry and remaining drawing quota.

tools.name: guard_bind
tools.description: Bind a QQ group name to a Bilibili nickname so later lookups (guard_check, welcome) recognise the same person.

qq_name.description: Name shown in the QQ group.

bili_name.description: The Bilibili nickname that appears in the guard roster.

summary.zh: 把群名片和 B站昵称绑成一个人，之后查舰长、欢迎都用得上。
summary.en: Bind a QQ display name to a Bilibili nickname.

tools.name: guard_portrait_save
tools.description: Save a congratulation-portrait draft (prompt + optional avatar path) for a guard without drawing it yet. The draft waits for the owner's confirmation before any image is generated.

prompt.description: Full image prompt: style, scene and the greeting text to write on the picture.

avatar_path.description: Local avatar path already fetched; leave empty if none.

summary.zh: 存一张舰长祝贺画的草稿（提示词+头像），等主人确认后才画。
summary.en: Save a guard portrait draft and wait for the owner's confirmation.

tools.name: guard_portrait_pending
tools.description: List the guard portraits that are still waiting for the owner's confirmation.

summary.zh: 列出还没确认的祝贺画草稿。
summary.en: List guard portraits still waiting for confirmation.

tools.name: guard_portrait_done
tools.description: Mark a guard portrait as delivered, so the same guard is not drawn again this month.

summary.zh: 标记这张祝贺画已交付，避免同一个人这个月被画第二次。
summary.en: Mark a portrait as delivered for this month.

tools.name: avatar_fetch
tools.description: Fetch a person's avatar image locally. Give a Bilibili UID when the source is the live room, or a QQ number when it comes from the group.

uid.description: Bilibili numeric UID (meta.uid of danmaku / guard events).

name.description: Display name, used as the file name.

summary.zh: 抓头像到本地：直播间给 B站 UID，群里给 QQ 号。
summary.en: Fetch an avatar locally by Bilibili UID or QQ number.

tools.name: draw_quota
tools.description: Check or consume a guard's daily drawing quota. `check` only reports; `use` records one drawing and must be called after the image is finished.

who.description: The person's group card or nickname, exactly as shown.

action.description: check = only look; use = record one drawing (call after the image is done).

summary.zh: 查/扣舰长的每日画图额度：check 只看，use 记一张（画完才调）。
summary.en: Check or consume a guard's daily drawing quota.
